job.job_description:
Experienced PYTHON/DJANGO BACKEND DEVELOPER. Enthusiastic about developing highly scalable, foolproof, end-to-end quality software. Then, you are the one we are looking for. You are very agile in planning your day, so you code day in day out without breaking a sweat. You are very passionate about data structures and algorithms. You are flexible in working with multidisciplinary teams and you push your teammates to their limits & ensure that the work is done.
Responsibilities and Duties
Implement product features with clean and robust code.
Closely working with designers and front-end developers to make sure the best user experience possible.
Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders to build truly world-class software.
Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications
Good understanding of data structures and algorithms
Good hold of Object Oriented Programming concepts
Working knowledge of Python and Django Framework (Must)
Knowledge of GIT version control
Understanding of REST
Knowledge of any database (PostgreSQL preferred)
Basics of Linux and Server handling is a plus


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
